# TTB & GrowthBook | First Meeting
Date: 2026-09-09 | Duration: 32.709999084472656m

## Summary
TTB Bank Thailand is experiencing Firebase cost concerns, with approximately 10 million daily requests and expected growth. Firebase is also blocked in China, resulting in 3,000–5,000 failed requests daily; these failures are non-critical but delay configuration updates. GrowthBook’s open-source and SaaS options were discussed, including enterprise security features, dedicated support, 24/7 availability, fast SLA, and the need for local support or a Thailand contact under bank policy. The customer operates a hybrid on-premises and AKS environment and is primarily focused on configuration management and application distribution, while monitoring integration with the data warehouse is a low priority. GrowthBook uses the data warehouse as a source of truth and provides SDK integration for experiments and feature flags, although data warehouse integration is optional. Pricing includes a base license and per-user seats, with an expected user count of 5–15, unlimited feature flags and experiments, no request limits, and flexible seat management. The customer plans to submit a proposal to its boss within this month, with bank committee approval expected this year. GrowthBook will provide detailed costs, customer success stories, and Asia-Pacific or Southeast Asian references.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Firebase, pricing, local support, feature flag, hybrid deployment
